title: A flexible hippocampal population code for experience relative to reward
goal: Reproduce and exceed the source-reported empirical method endpoint on identical original observations and evaluation support. Original Figure3b session mean cosine reward-relative-position decoding on all eleven mice, seven switch days and three retrospective cell classes, with all462 train-before condition rows within the retained1155-condition source panel and mandatory Figure3c spatial-generalization companions. This is original retrospective decoding, not prospective chronological adaptation. Complete Figure2 remapping and broader Figure2/3 biological reproduction remain independently scoped in unchanged root reproduction.v2.json and archived prior task. Figure3a illustration and biological significance/effect-size summaries remain there; stronger cosine does not establish stronger remapping or full-family reproduction.

success_criteria: Recreate the selected original method endpoint and all declared source companions using authentic source observations and independently verified submitted computation.

Exceed the strongest relevant authenticated author comparator only after meaningful native-unit full-panel superiority and mouse-level uncertainty rules are frozen; preserving original task inputs/splits/metric is mandatory.

Preserve broader biological reproduction separately; method gains do not imply a larger biological effect or current SOTA.

A higher shuffle score, standardized significance or arbitrary real-minus-shuffle effect is not an optimization win.
